links.outcome: Readability of online and AI-generated PIFP patient information (Flesch Reading Ease, SMOG)
links.effect: All sources, including ChatGPT and Gemini content, were rated as difficult to read; AI content was more understandable on PEMAT (83.31% vs 64.96%, p<0.001).
links.quote: All sources were rated as "difficult" to read.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation benchmarking LLM responses (ChatGPT, Gemini) against traditional web search results for Persistent Idiopathic Facial Pain patient education without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
